result.summary: Adds a test verifying that receiving duplicate `wtxidrelay` messages from an inbound peer before `verack` does not increment `m_wtxid_relay_peers` multiple times. It tests that the duplicate message is safely ignored without disconnecting the peer, and ensures `m_wtxid_relay_peers` returns to zero on node finalization.
result.problem: Bitcoin Core lacks test coverage ensuring duplicate `wtxidrelay` messages are ignored rather than double-counting towards `m_wtxid_relay_peers`, which would cause an internal consistency assertion to fail during `FinalizeNode`.
evidence: Author notes the test kills a specific mutant in `net_processing.cpp` (https://mutanthub.space/mutants/3756) where `m_wtxid_relay_peers` was incremented outside the `!peer.m_wtxid_relay` check.
result.card: Adds a test verifying that duplicate wtxidrelay messages sent before verack do not double-increment the wtxid relay peer counter. Without coverage, regressions in net processing could allow duplicate messages to corrupt the counter and trigger an internal consistency check failure in FinalizeNode. The test kills a mutant identified by automated mutation testing.
uncertainties: The patch diff was not provided, but the commit message and PR description detail the exact test behavior and mutation covered.

risk.why: Touches only test code and has no impact on production node behavior.
